using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using JetBrains.Annotations;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;

public class AbpCommandLineOptions : Dictionary<string, string>
{
    public AbpCommandLineOptions()
    {
    }

    public AbpCommandLineOptions([NotNull] AbpCommandLineOptions other)
        : base(other)
    {
    }

    public bool ContainsKey([NotNull] string key, [NotNull] string longKey)
    {
        return ContainsKey(key) || ContainsKey(longKey);
    }

    public string GetOrNull([NotNull] string key, [NotNull] string longKey)
    {
        if (TryGetValue(key, out var value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        if (TryGetValue(longKey, out value))
        {
            return value;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public bool Any()
    {
        return Count > 0;
    }
}
